Span: Sep 17–24, 2012.
Anchor: main 26929 (Sep 18, 2012, Lesley Groff→Nili, subject "Jeffrey Epstein"): "Hi Nili... Jeffrey says he is free to meet with Ehud anytime from Friday Sept. 21st onwards... so what ever is most convenient for Ehud!... does not need to be Monday 24th.. please do let me know what suits his schedule best and we will do it." Quoted inside, Nili→Groff, Sep 18, 11:30 AM: "Hi lesley, first we would like a solo meeting with Jeffrey before Monday. On Monday o.k. around noon. We fly back at 5 p.m. Best Nili." (Friday Sep 21 and Monday Sep 24, 2012 check out as the calendar dates for that week.) New York is implied by "we fly back at 5 p.m."; the city is not named in the row.
Endpoint / dated stopping point: Sep 24, 2012 — the arrangement arc runs to the scheduled noon gathering at the Regency Hotel, Room 1131; completion is still NOT established (no post-event record in the sweep; no Sep 25 follow-up found; the Monday-afternoon messages still speak of the noon meeting prospectively and the Friday 8:14 PM instruction postdates its own 5 PM slot — both tensions flagged, not resolved). The Sep 2012 messages are DOJ-only: '1131' scores 0 hits across all five Barak DBs and no Sep 2012 Regency message is in the leak mailbox. The v3.2 'no follow-up found' is superseded by the v3.3 WS2 DS11 sweep below; the v3.2 DOJ cross-check's inconclusive result is replaced by the sweep's dated cluster.
Why it matters: this is the earliest documented Epstein contact in the mailbox, ~8 months before the atlas's earliest (Apr 22, 2013, main 27747, Epstein's Summers introduction; May 9, 2013, the Putin proposal, leak id 28024). The Barak–Epstein relationship evidently predates May 2013 in the mailbox record. It does not change Story 18 (the paid arrangement, Nov–Dec 2013) or Story 12 (May 2013–Feb 2019) — it is a separate, earlier prologue leg, reported as its own probable story (coordinator's placement decision; see changelog §1).
Tier: probable, not confirmed — a meeting was arranged in writing by both sides' schedulers; whether it took place is not in rows read. A schedule is never a held event (Standard rule 3). Links: Story 12, Story 18.
v3.3-corrected (Nov 6, 2026): classification reviewed after external review — P43 stays a standalone probable story (see changelog §11). The arrangement chain meets the atlas definition and the v1.3 P13 precedent: the arrangement itself is the documented decision, ending at the explicit dated stopping point Sep 24, 2012. It is not a fragment (a week-long arc across 15 contents, not a single scheduling memo) and not a Story 12 extension (the eight-month gap to Apr/May 2013 has no connecting document).
Verification (v3.2, WS3): document-level verified — anchor body-read in full.

v3.3 (WS2) extension — the DS11 Sep-2012 sweep: the DOJ-side follow-through is now documented (15 distinct contents; 18 IDs incl. 3 duplicate copies). Windows searched: `data_set : 11 AND "September 2012"` → 22 docs (all 22 triaged by head; none mentions Barak); `data_set : 11 AND Groff AND Barak AND September` → 43 docs (all triaged by head); Bates-range windows EFTA02559000–EFTA02562000 (2,212 docs, 26 keyword hits), EFTA02558000–EFTA02559000 (715 docs, 0 Sep-2012 Barak hits), EFTA02562000–EFTA02563000 (746 docs, 0), EFTA02700000–EFTA02703000 (2,020 docs; 2 hits, both cluster duplicates). Leak-mailbox check: "Regency" and "1131" across all five Barak DBs — no Sep 2012 Regency message in the leak mailbox ("1131" scores 0 everywhere). **The cluster is DOJ-only material.** In chronological order, all Groff→Epstein unless noted: Sep 17–18, 2012 — Epstein↔Larry Summers: Epstein (Mon Sep 17, 5:05 PM): "22-24". Summers (Sep 17, 3:36 PM): "When. I'm in Korea right now." Epstein (Tue Sep 18, 5:34 AM): "any interest in Ehud, at my house". Reply at the top of the chain (Tue Sep 18, 12:32 AM; sender blank in the text layer): "Will be in nyc on 24 mostly free." (EFTA02560037 — direct Epstein–Summers contact about Barak; also the P12 leg.) Tue Sep 18, 2012, 3:37 PM — "Barak/Larry Summers" (EFTA02559810): "Barak says he would like a solo meeting with you on Monday Sept. 24th at noon and he flies back at 5pm. What time do you want Larry Summers to join? Should this be a lunch?" — Groff relaying Nili's message; the mirror of main 26929, with the new element that Larry Summers was to join at some point. Tue Sep 18, 2012, 3:51 PM — "Barak — tell me exactly please" (EFTA02559880): "Please tell me exactly what you would like me to ask Nili for when it comes to Barak… 'A solo meeting with you and Barak sometime Sat, Sun or Mon, whenever convenient for him, possibly for a meal or just coffee'" — Epstein's instruction to Groff, 14 minutes after the previous message. Thu Sep 20, 2012, 11:41 AM — "Barak" (EFTA02559941): forwards Nili (Thu Sep 20, 6:49 AM): "ehud will be back from washington tomorrow friday around 4 pm, will jeffrey be so kind as to come over to the hotel (regency on park avenue and 61st… as flights are imprevisible, i shall call you upon his arrival so jeffrey won't be waiting. please confirm". **The plan shifts: Friday Sep 21, Epstein to come to Barak's hotel after ~4 PM.** Fri Sep 21, 2012, 11:41 AM — "Schedule" (EFTA02561234; duplicate copy EFTA02701667, same remote-id 247046, same timestamp; the copy adds "3:00 Nina Keita"): Friday schedule: "11:00 Katya; 11:30; 12:30 Lunch with Steven Kosslyn; 1:30 conf call with Kosslyn's attorneys; 3:00; **5:15 Go See Barak at Regency**; 7:00 Dinner with Michael Wood." **The Barak visit is on Epstein's calendar for Friday 5:15 PM.** Fri Sep 21, 2012, 1:58 PM — "Barak Regency Room #1131" (EFTA02560908): "Barak is in Room room no. 1131 at the Regency Hotel, Park Ave & 61st." Fri Sep 21, 2012, 8:14 PM — "JE to be AT REGENCY AT 5pm — Rm#1131" (EFTA02560494, to Janusz Banasiak and Richard Barnett, Epstein CC'd): "Jeffrey is to be at the Regency at 5pm. Park Ave and 61st. Room 1131." (Sent at 8:14 PM, after the 5 PM slot — reported as written; see below.) Sun Sep 23, 2012, 8:59 PM — "Has Barak meeting been moved to 11am?" (EFTA02561225): "Have you heard if 11am will work for tomorrow with Barak? Larry Summers' assistants are asking because they need to change his airline tickets. Please advise." Mon Sep 24, 2012 — "Larry Summers" (EFTA02560633; duplicate copy EFTA02366153, same remote-id 247637, same text): "I confirmed with Larry Summers assistants you will meet Larry in the lobby of the Regency at 11am today." Mon Sep 24, 2012, 12:29 PM — "9:15 Karyna/Janusz" (EFTA02559879): "Janusz is a bit concerned about being back in time to get you to the Regency from dropping Karyna at school this morning. Should Karyna leave earlier than 9:15 for school to ensure Janusz is back in plenty of time for you?" — Epstein being driven to the Regency that day. Mon Sep 24, 2012, 1:56 PM — "Reid confirmed 11:45 in room" (EFTA02560130): "Reid has confirmed he will be at the room at the Regency at 11:45 today. Regency Hotel, Park Ave & 61st, Room 1131." "Reid" — surname not stated in the document (Reid Hoffman, who appears elsewhere in the atlas, is a candidate; the document does not establish the identification). v3.4 (WS3) note: a second 'Reid' exists in Epstein's orbit — Reid Weingarten, documented as Epstein's counsel only in 2019 (bail letter, EFTA00058429; bail-hearing transcript, EFTA00015606) — but no document connects either Weingarten or Hoffman to the Sep 24, 2012 Regency meeting; the identification stays NOT established. Mon Sep 24, 2012, 3:05 PM — "Joe Pagano" (EFTA02560251; duplicate copy EFTA02701903, same timestamp/text): "Joe Pagano asked where he is to meet you at noon… he thought he was to come to the house… I told [name unclear in text layer] you will be at the Regency at noon… FYI — Nili has not responded to my email asking if ok for Joe Pagano to come at noon…" Mon Sep 24, 2012, 3:07 PM — "Nili! re Joe Pagano" (EFTA02560282): "Nili says 'we count on Jeffrey-ok' re would it be ok for Joe Pagano to come along as well at noon today.." Mon Sep 24, 2012, 3:08 PM — "Joe Pagano will be in lobby at 11:50" (EFTA02560305): "Joe says he will be in the lobby at the Regency at 11:50 so you don't have to wait on him…" (A phone number follows in the document; not reproduced here, per the Standard's no-PII rule.) Mon Sep 24, 2012, 2:39 PM — Ian Osborne→Epstein, "Re: What's the plan at 12 today?" (EFTA02560221): "Great, I will see you there." Quoting Epstein (Sep 24): "You and a few friends regency hotel 12 rm 1131". **Epstein's own words placing the noon gathering at the Regency, Room 1131, with "a few friends".** What the sweep establishes: the arrangement did not end with main 26929. The DOJ side carries the negotiation forward day by day: the Monday-noon solo plan (Sep 18) → a Friday-afternoon hotel visit plan (Sep 20) → the Friday 5:15 PM calendar entry and the Regency Room 1131 logistics (Sep 21) → the Sunday-evening open question about moving Monday to 11 AM (Sep 23) → the Monday convergence: Summers in the lobby at 11 AM, Reid at the room at 11:45, Pagano in the lobby at 11:50, Epstein expected at noon in Room 1131, with Nili's "we count on Jeffrey-ok" for Pagano joining. The venue is established (Regency Hotel, Park Ave & 61st, Room 1131); Larry Summers' participation is established as planned (invited Sep 17–18, lobby meeting 11 AM Sep 24); Ian Osborne's attendance is established as planned (Epstein's own message). **Completion is still NOT established** — no document in the sweep records the meeting as having taken place: no debrief, no thank-you, no "good meeting" note, no Sep 25 follow-up (`Barak AND "September 25"` → 0; `Regency AND "September 25"` → 0). Two cautions against over-reading: (a) the Friday 8:14 PM instruction "JE to be AT REGENCY AT 5pm" (EFTA02560494) was sent *after* the 5 PM slot it names; (b) the Monday 3:05–3:08 PM messages (EFTA02560251/282/305) still speak of the noon meeting prospectively ("would it be ok for Joe Pagano to come along as well at noon today"), which sits oddly against a noon start — the timestamps are reported as the documents state them and the tension is flagged, not resolved. A schedule is never a held event (Standard rule 3). **P43 stays probable, not confirmed.** The story's shape changes from "single exchange, no follow-up" to "a week-long arrangement arc with a scheduled venue and converging attendees, completion not established." Placement: P43 stays its own probable story — the new material strengthens it without merging it into Story 12; the eight-month gap to Apr/May 2013 still has no connecting document. Duplicate copies are cited as copies (same remote-id), not independent corroboration.

v3.5 (WS3) extension — 'Reid' as a recurring first-name-only contact, and a next-day data point. (EFTA02327315); Feb 12, 2018, 'Reid 830 am tomorrow' (EFTA02237269) — no surname in any document read. Span: May 7 – Jul 17, 2013.
Anchors: main 27908 (May 7, 2013, Jack Bendheim→Barak, CC Jonathan): "Ehud when u have 15 minutes I would appreciate it if you could sit with Jonathan to discuss a project." Barak replies (same day, in-chain): "jack, i'll do. where is he? I'll be in IL in Shavouth. In NY this Sat for few hrs."; main 27915 (May 8, 2013, Jonathan→Barak, CC Jack): "Please let me know what dates/times would work for you to meet in Israel and I will make one of the times work."; main 27926 (May 22, 2013, Jonathan→Barak): "I wanted to thank you again for taking the time to meet with me and Anshel on Friday" — the meeting was held (Friday May 17, 2013). Follow-up: Barak asked Jonathan to reach out to Ziv Lautenberg and to "walk Doron through the offering"; Jonathan asks Barak "to once again consider getting involved with business in whatever capacity you see fit. While it has taken time for Nowforce.com to build a strong and sustainable platform, the business [is] finally at a stage where it is ready to significantly accelerate its growth and take advantage of the very real global opportunity that exists for our solution."; main 31158 (Jul 17, 2013, Barak→Jonathan, quoting the May 22–29 chain): Barak's May 22 reply — "Thanks. Will discuss it again during the wedding. In the meantime try to talk to Danny Yatom former head of Mossad and CoS to me. He runs a security co. which might help in promoting it. I've told him about your co." — and Jonathan's May 29 report: "we had a meeting with Danny Yatom and his son at their office. We agreed on next steps for him to make introductions with some of his relationships in relevant orgs/people in the US. Thank you again for making the introduction." Barak, Jul 17: "Jonathan Thx. Yatom is very practical. VG. EB".
Endpoint / dated stopping point: Jul 17, 2013 (Barak's endorsement of Yatom). Barak's own involvement with Nowforce itself is NOT established in rows read. "Nowforce" totals 3 main hits + 2 Hyperion hits across all five DBs; nothing after Jul 17, 2013. Whether Barak ever engaged, and what Yatom's introductions produced, would need sources outside this mailbox.
Tier: probable, not confirmed — the chain is real (introduction → completed meeting → documented follow-through to Yatom), but the story's natural endpoint (whether Barak got involved with Nowforce, and what Yatom's introductions produced) is not in rows read. Business/association record, not an allegation. People: Ehud Barak, Jack C. Bendheim (introducer), Jonathan Bendheim, "Anshel" (meeting attendee, surname not in rows read), Danny Yatom (former head of Mossad and Barak's former chief of staff, per Barak's May 22 message), Ziv Lautenberg (Barak's former son-in-law, per Jonathan's May 22 message), "Doron" (surname not in rows read). Links: Story 14 (same 2013 investment orbit; distinct arc, kept separate).
Verification (v3.2, WS3): document-level verified — anchors body-read in full.

v3.3 (WS2) extension — outside-the-mailbox chase (clean negative on follow-through, with two incidental DOJ mentions and one identity candidate): **No Nowforce/Yatom/Barak follow-through was found outside the mailbox: no contract, no funding, no dated end.** Whether Barak ever engaged with Nowforce, and what Yatom's introductions produced, remain not established — now after a DOJ-wide and HO search, not just a mailbox search. What was searched (DOJ corpus, all sets; House Oversight): `Nowforce` → **2 docs** (EFTA02370081 DS11; EFTA01074376 DS9), HO **0**; `Bendheim` → **13 docs** (1 DS9, 12 DS10), HO **0**; `Yatom` → **1 doc** (EFTA00973971 DS9), HO **40 pages** — all Barak's memoir (Danny Yatom as his Sayeret deputy/security aide), duplicated across Parts 1 and 9; no Nowforce content; `Goldwasser` → 10 docs, 0 in DS11, none Benad; `"Shanghai Alliance"` → **0**. This is a clean negative **stating what was searched**, not an absolute negative: absence in the searched material proves only absence in the searched material. The two DOJ "Nowforce" hits: EFTA01074376 (DS9, 40 pp.) — Reporty Homeland Security Ltd, Business Plan 2014: the single "NowForce" mention sits in a market-products list (p. 26) — a comparable-company listing inside the Reporty plan, not a Nowforce follow-through (shared with Story 20, where the plan is the leg); EFTA02370081 (DS11, 3 pp.) — AFHU E-Connections newsletter, sent Tue Jul 8, 2014: "Anshel Pfeffer, a Hebrew University alumnus, co-founded NowForce, which provides mobile solutions for emergency response organizations." Press/newsletter content only — no Barak, Bendheim, Yatom, contract, or funding. **The "Anshel" identity candidate (NOT confirmed):** P44's meeting attendee is "Anshel" (surname not in rows read). **"Anshel" occurs exactly once in the entire DOJ corpus: EFTA02370081, as "Anshel Pfeffer".** That document also states Pfeffer co-founded NowForce — the company whose pitch meeting P44's "Anshel" attended with Jonathan Bendheim on Fri May 17, 2013. Proposed reading (candidate, not confirmed): P44's "Anshel" is Anshel Pfeffer. The evidence is circumstantial but specific: same first name, same company, and the only "Anshel" in 1.38M DOJ documents. Per Standard rule 6 this is **not** asserted as an identification — the documents do not state it, and the two items come from different source families (leak mailbox vs. DOJ newsletter). Carry both readings: "Anshel (surname not in rows read; 'Anshel Pfeffer', named as NowForce co-founder in a Jul 8, 2014 newsletter, EFTA02370081, is a candidate identification, not established)." The other hits, all checked: the 13 Bendheim docs are unrelated Bendheims (Deutsche Bank statements with income distributions to "KATHY BENDHEIM" / "THOMAS L BENDHEIM" / "CATHERINE L BENDHEIM" — EFTA01255960, EFTA01299408, EFTA01299483, EFTA01299542; client/trust lists naming "BENDHEIM, JOHN M", "Bendheim, Andrew", "Bendheim Jr., John M." — EFTA01398754, EFTA01398949, EFTA01460973; four copies of one Deutsche Bank questionnaire about "Andrew J Bendheim" — EFTA01456920, EFTA01456922, EFTA01456930, EFTA01472504, EFTA01472507, EFTA01472510 — EFTA01472510 clarifies "our client is Jeffrey Epstein per the subject line and not Andrew J Bendheim as you mentioned in question #2"). **No Jack Bendheim, no Jonathan Bendheim, no Nowforce, no Yatom in any of the 13.** EFTA00973971 (DS9, 24 pp.) — a Daily Beast article quoting "Danny Yatom, a former chief of Israel's intelligence service, the Mossad, in an interview" about Turkish intelligence burning agents to Iran. Press quote; no Nowforce, Barak, or Bendheim link. (The Bendheim/Yatom noise IDs are recorded here as checked-and-not-added; they are not anchors and are not in the JSON.)

The investigation's outcome is the USAO decline, as stated in the Jul 2024 FBI account (EFTA00155090) — a summary written 13 years after the events, cited as the FBI's 2024 account, not as a contemporaneous record. The 2016 SDNY approach opened no investigation (same source). A discrete episode with a beginning (Jul–Oct 2010 Fisten/FBI meetings + victim interviews), a middle (Mar 9, 2011 victim interview + preliminary-investigation memo), and an endpoint (2011 USAO decline; 2016 SDNY approach opened no investigation; Jul 2024 FBI account). It answers Story 2's open "decade of inaction" lead for 2010–2011 but is not a leg of the breach-declaration chain — a connected chain with its own endpoint, kept standalone (coordinator's decision, see changelog §8). Whether anything followed between late 2011 and the 2018–2019 case is still not established in the material read.

Span: May 26, 2013 – Jun 5, 2015.
Anchors: main 28023 (May 29, 2013, filed under "economic Forum at St. Petersburg"; body is Shilin's Jun 5, 2013 message): Barak's May 26, 2013 request quoted inside — "I'm former Prime Minister of Israel and two months since ending six years of service as Israel's Minister of Defense. I would like to meet with President Putin for 30–40min at an early opportunity. Preferably before the main June Events." Shilin (Jun 5): "We respectfully ask you to call Ambassador Yuri Ushakov as soon as it is convenient for you to discuss your meeting with President Putin."; main 1407 (filed Jul 2, 2013 under "The payment VV July@VV #Invoices"; body is Barak's Jun 5, 2013, 16:16 reply): "Alexey Thanks. I will call Ambassador Ushakov in one hour from now, If that works for you." — the Jul 2 date is a filing date, not a message date; main 1155 (filed Jun 24, 2013; body is Barak's Jun 12, 2013, 22:36 sent mail) quoting Shilin, Jun 11, 2013, 14:44: "Dear Mr. Barack, On behalf of my boss I am privileged to tell you that we will do our best to organize your meeting with President Putin on June 20 at 19:30 in Saint-Petersburg. It must work. If it fails — which is unlikely — boss will find another opportunity." Barak, Jun 12: "Thank Ambassador Ushakov on my behalf for setting the meeting. I'd never spent the time of the President and won't do it now. This meeting IS important. So make sure it's done during the SPEIF."; main 24058 (filed Jul 20, 2013; body is the Jun 11 Shilin message as forwarded — same thread, shorter filing than main 1155, which additionally carries Barak's Jun 12 reply; distinct filings of the same thread, not independent corroboration); main 15467 (filed Jan 21, 2015, "Touch Base YU") and main 15540 (same thread, shorter filing): Barak, Jan 19, 2015, to Ushakov — plans "a short visit to Moscow late next week on Thursday, January 29th in the afternoon" and asks for "a brief, 30 minutes meeting" with the President. Shilin, Jan 20, 2015: "even a brief meeting with Mr. Putin on January 29 is impossible because of President's extremely tough schedule that day. So Amb. Ushakov respectfully asks whether you could suggest some other dates for this meeting." Barak, Jan 21, 2015, 12:36: "Unfortunately I cannot make it this time on another day. However, I'm confident a meeting will be interesting and fruitful for both. I'll be glad to meet with the President in any date and venue of Ambassador Ushakov choice on any day between Friday, Feb 27th and Friday, March 20th." Whether any Feb 27–Mar 20 meeting was arranged or held is NOT established in rows read (no follow-up in the Shilin rows read; the next Ushakov rows are Jun 2015); main 12708 (filed Jun 10, 2015 under "Reshef Amnon") and main 12911 (same thread, shorter filing): Barak, Jun 3, 2015, to Ushakov — "I'm going to participate in SPEIF 2015. I'll be in St. Petersburg from June 17th evening through June 21st morning. I've already set meetings with Min. Lavrov and Gov. Nabiullina. I'll highly appreciate it if I'll be allowed to have a sh[ort meeting with the President]…" Shilin, Jun 4, 2015: "Most unfortunately President's schedule in Saint-Petersburg doesn't leave any possibility for even a shortest additional meeting… Boss wonders whether you could suggest any other dates for your new visit to Russia so that he could try to arrange your meeting with the President." Barak, Jun 5, 2015, 16:49: "First, I would like to leave open with Ambassador Ushakov my request for a meeting with the President during SPEIF 2015, just in case somehow an opening will occur along the way. Second, I am really interesting in this meeting and confident it'll be mutually beneficial. So, if you give me a date and place where it is possible I will change my schedule to enable it."
Endpoint / dated stopping point: Jun 5, 2015 — Barak leaves the SPIEF 2015 Putin request open with Ushakov ("just in case somehow an opening will occur"); no Putin meeting is arranged in rows read. Three dated legs over two years, one channel (Barak→Ushakov→Shilin), one subject (a direct Barak–Putin meeting), with an arc — arranged, then declined, then declined again. Leg (a) May–Jun 2013: meeting requested, then arranged for Jun 20, 2013, 19:30, St. Petersburg; held/not-held NOT established (no post-June-20 confirmation, report, or follow-up in the Shilin rows read; the arrangement — "we will do our best to organize", "make sure it's done" — is not a held-meeting record). Leg (b) Jan 2015: requested for Jan 29, 2015 (Moscow); declined for that date; counter-offer Feb 27–Mar 20, 2015; outcome NOT established. Leg (c) Jun 2015: requested for SPIEF 2015; declined — independent corroboration, from Ushakov's office rather than Belyakov, that no Putin meeting was arranged at SPIEF 2015, consistent with the Jun 8, 2015 Belyakov cancellation ("This year we won't be able to make the 1-1 session") already in Story 31. Distinct from Story 12's Epstein-mediated Putin proposal (May 9, 2013, leak id 28024: Epstein→Barak, "let Putin know you will be in Moscow") — the Ushakov channel is Barak acting directly, 17 days after Epstein's proposal, and no document in rows read connects the two; the connection is not claimed. Kept standalone, not a Story 12 extension (coordinator's decision, see changelog §8): the channel, participants, and arc are self-contained. stories.entry_markdown:
Span: Dec 6, 2001 – Nov 29, 2004.
Anchors: DS8: EFTA00022654
Chain: EFTA00022654 (12 pp., 48,093 chars; full text read). The document itself runs Dec 2001–Oct 10, 2005; this story uses its Dec 2001–Nov 2004 entries. The Mar–Oct 2005 entries are a Story 1 extension. No "PBAC" / "Palm Beach Atlantic" / "22654" / "OCVAN" hits exist in v3.4 or in the prior DS8 reports — new to the atlas. Dec 6–7, 2001: OCVAN received intelligence from West Palm Beach PD concerning Maxwell — "hiring young women from PBAC to come to her house and answer the phone… paid $200.00 per day… It is unclear what is occurring in the residence."
Dec 10, 2001 (recorded in an Oct 13, 2003 file note): three Palm Beach Atlantic College female students approached by an English woman identifying herself as Maxwell on campus; she needed "young, beautiful unmarried women to answer phones and do office work"; one went to the house several times; "men call in saying when they were going to drop off particular girls"; "at least two of the girls complained about Epstein touching them inappropriately"; Maxwell asked for a list of other girls to call on short notice; "large pool of girls." Follow-up attempts to reach the girls failed (college closed for the semester; messages left in January met with negative results).
Jan 28–Apr 16, 2002 (trash pulls): massage directory listings, phone messages, daily calendars, a list of female names titled "People that I want you to meet" (ages, descriptions, what they do), BellSouth bills under Epstein's and Maxwell's names, correspondence indicating "a weapon is kept on the property," financial information, nude photographs of women, numerous references to massages.
Feb 8–13, 2002: investigative subpoena for incoming/outgoing lines to 358 El Brillo Way, served on BellSouth. Feb 12, 2002: corporations inquiry — Financial Strategy Group, Inc.; Ghislaine Corp; Financial Trustees, Inc. — none active. Feb 22, 2002: BellSouth lines at 358 El Brillo Way under G. Maxwell / Jeffrey Epstein. Feb 27–Mar 11 and Mar 19–29, 2002: further subpoenas; phone records evaluated — "nothing unusual was detected" except numerous phone lines. Mar 26, 2002: drive-by surveillance (vehicle tags).
Apr 12, 2002: PBAC Security room search — Smirnoff Ice bottles, papers with porn-site addresses, a note about adult work paying $2,200/week.
Apr 24, 2002: interviews with two students — both confirmed approached by Maxwell, worked at the residence briefly answering phones, "were paid well"; felt something "weird" about the residents; "did not observe anything illegal at the time."
Apr 25, 2002: interview with a third student — did not recall anything illegal; "there were nude photographs of women all over the residence"; women around the pool topless; "Epstein offered [her] a massage at one time... Maxwell had [her] take her top off for the massage... made [her] extremely uncomfortable and [she] has not been back since."
Conclusion as written (Apr 25, 2002 entry): "Although it appears as though unusual activity is occurring at this residence, at this time, no illegal activity has been reported or detected. This information will remain as intelligence purposes only, until a crime is reported or possibly another student or young female [comes forward]..."
Mar 5–11, 2004: a woman reported Epstein repeatedly asked her to take off her top or pants; she refused; she filed a complaint and said she would work with police.
Aug 10, 2004: a taxi driver flagged down an officer — he had dropped off two females appearing ~15 and 17 at Epstein's residence and overheard them discussing money they would make "dating" in Palm Beach and possible drug use. Drive-by followed; "efforts will be made to commence trash pulls from Epstein's residence in the near future."
Nov 29, 2004: the property manager reported a suspicious vehicle; a woman picked up an envelope from Epstein — "money for being a message therapist"; she confided Epstein "has many young girls come over… there's always a different young girl at the pool or inside with him."
Endpoint / dated stopping point: Nov 29, 2004 (EFTA00022654 — last pre-2005 intelligence entry). The Apr 25, 2002 conclusion ("intelligence purposes only") is the story's internal close; the header disposition reads UNFOUNDED.
Tier: probable, not confirmed — the file is a Palm Beach Police case report / "Persons System Report" for Epstein (case 2002-10; entries are filed under several file numbers, including File 100, 300, 300-13 and 2600; "Prostitution-Epstein"; header disposition UNFOUNDED). Its contents are officers' records of what students and others told them — accounts and allegations, labeled as such — and the file's own conclusion is that no illegal activity had been reported or detected at that time. The header disposition and the narrative conclusion are both reported as recorded; neither is treated as a finding of fact about the underlying conduct.
Links: Story 1 (the 2005 investigation — the same file's Mar–Oct 2005 entries are a Story 1 leg); Story 5 (Maxwell case).
Verification (v3.5, WS1): document-level verified — anchors body-read in full.
